_comment: Which CMS datasets to pull. Titles are matched case-insensitively as
substrings against the live CMS catalog, so partial titles are fine and
preferred -- CMS appends dates and version suffixes to titles.
Run `hhpanel discover` after editing to confirm each one still resolves.

sources.role: Outcome variables: quality of patient care star rating, HHCAHPS survey star rating, declared ownership type.
Treatment variable: owner roster per enrollment, including owner type and percentage.
Bridge table: enrollment id -> CCN. Required to join owners to Care Compare.
Provenance: the measurement period each Care Compare refresh actually covers.
